title: Has anyone been here?
content: I have this reoccurring dream where I’m in a house that has a hidden floor and the only way to get to it is by this long hallway that is winding and has stairs but it’s covered in velvet. And the hidden floor is a huge ballroom. I’m not allowed to go to this hidden floor unless I’m with the guy. The guy is a super tall pale being that feels like maybe a ghost or vampire. He showed me the hidden room and told me I’m only allowed to visit with him there. Last night I had the dream and he wasn’t there but I tried going to the hidden floor but I woke up before I got there.
